# AI Chip Startup Tenstorrent Raises Funds at $6.2 Billion Value

AI chip startup Tenstorrent Inc., after attracting takeover interest earlier this year, has raised $1.5 billion from investors in a funding round that boosts its valuation to $6.2 billion, according to a statement provided to Bloomberg News.

Trace Capital, a firm started this year by Quiet Capital co-founder Ben Mahdavi, led the Series E financing, alongside Innovation X, Tenstorrent said in the statement.
